start.title: Puzzle 1 Start
start.description: You look at the switches on the wall. There seem to be sixteen of them. Remembering the words on the pedestal, you hope for the best.

stage.title: Puzzle 1 [#]
stage.description: You move to switch number [#]. The question is, do you toggle it, or move on to the next one?

fail.title: Failed
fail.description: As you move, the stone slams shut, plunging you into absolute darkness. You hear a sound like sand falling, and realize the walls are shifting.
